item.title: Lagos govt clears roadside markets along Ikotun-Igando axis
item.description: Lagos State Government, on Saturday, carried out an enforcement operation to remove roadside markets along the Ikotun-Igando Road in Alimosho Local Government Area. The action was confirmed by the Commissioner for Environment and Water Resources, Tokunbo Wahab, in a post shared on his official X handle, alongside video footage of the exercise. According to Wahab, […] Lagos govt clears roadside markets along Ikotun-Igando axis

item.title: Ex-Katsina SSG accuses Gov Radda of withholding LG funds
item.description: A former Secretary to the Katsina State Government, Dr. Mustapha Mohammed Inuwa, has accused Governor Dikko Umaru Radda of withholding funds meant for the state’s 34 local government councils despite a Supreme Court judgment granting councils financial autonomy. item.title: NiMet forecasts 3-day sunshine, haziness from Sunday
item.description: The Nigerian Meteorological Agency, NiMet, has predicted sunshine and hazy conditions across the country from Sunday to Tuesday. In its weather outlook released on Saturday in Abuja, NiMet forecast sunny skies over the northern region throughout the period, with hazy atmospheric conditions expected over the North-Central states. item.title: AFCON 2025: Super Eagles’ group opponent hit by allowance dispute

item.title: Fire guts FIRS Headquarters ahead of New Tax laws rollout
item.description: The Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) has confirmed that a fire incident occurred at one of its offices within its Abuja headquarters on Saturday, days ahead of the January 2026 implementation of Nigeria’s new tax laws.
